text:

Perfect example of almost every conversation I ever had with Trump.

Dan Driscoll did the right thing.
How many of us have to resign before America gets it? https://t.co/U4rtBKUzAt
— Former Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene🇺🇸 (@FmrRepMTG) September 2, 2026
Showed the same proclivity when asked about the death of Charlie Kirk.
Memories! https://t.co/M9RoHuVXn6
— Recover Republic (@RecoverRepub) September 2, 2026
